claim: *The upload-entitlement domain.* A user belongs to one or more groups; a group carries either a finite credit balance or unlimited use. The admission decision needs both facts, so a representation that can express only the finite balance cannot answer the question the decision asks.

topology.description: User-group multiplicity; finite/unlimited entitlement alternatives must both feed admission.

bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Common entitlement gray groups finite/unlimited alternatives and decision, preserving both inputs and admit/reject outcomes.
redesign: Common entitlement gray groups finite/unlimited alternatives and decision, preserving both inputs and admit/reject outcomes.
alt: A user belongs to one or more groups. The group branches into finite credits and unlimited entitlement. Both alternatives feed an upload decision ending in admit or reject; the decision must preserve both facts. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Common entitlement gray groups finite/unlimited alternatives and decision, preserving both inputs and admit/reject outcomes.
